verdict.rationale: Postman is mainly an API client and testing platform, but its docs mention a Fabric Gateway that registers MCP servers and makes them available to a team. That implies some mediation between consumers and upstream servers, so the gateway axis applies. Request routing is only implied, and only for MCP servers. Pre-request scripts and webhook forwarding are client- or dev-side features, not gateway traffic management. Missing for 10: general HTTP request routing rules, load balancing across upstreams, request/response transformation at the gateway, and any in-depth gateway docs or independent corroboration.
